correctness.rationale: Independently differentiated the exact Bernoulli/population entropy and factored its derivative after equilibrium substitutions: -beta_p*A(z)*(y-q)^2+Delta*w*((y-q)*(1-y)*A(z)-(1-q)*(1-alpha)*y*(z-p)); the symbolic difference was exactly zero. Scalar logistic equation makes w integrable. Nonnegative entropy bounds force y>0 and z strictly interior uniformly; integrability and uniform continuity imply y->q. Bounded second derivative and derivative decay then identify z->p by dividing y equation by y; w->0. Degenerate boundaries are explicitly excluded and positive finite rates have no small/large assumption. Mathematical compactness/convergence proof was reconstructed, not inferred from simulations.
